# CMakeLists.txt
#
# Build configuration for Slate.
# Requires Qt 6.8+ with the WebEngine module.

cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.19)

# Read version from VERSION.txt (single source of truth)
file(READ "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/VERSION.txt" SLATE_VERSION)
string(STRIP "${SLATE_VERSION}" SLATE_VERSION)
project(Slate VERSION ${SLATE_VERSION} LANGUAGES CXX)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)

# Qt6 requires this for autogenerated MOC/RCC files
set(CMAKE_AUTOMOC ON)
set(CMAKE_AUTORCC ON)

find_package(Qt6 6.8 REQUIRED COMPONENTS Widgets Network WebEngineWidgets Test)

set(SLATE_SOURCES
    src/Main.cpp
    src/MainWindow.cpp
    src/MainWindow.h
    src/TabBar.cpp
    src/TabBar.h
    src/AddressBar.cpp
    src/AddressBar.h
    src/Blocklist.cpp
    src/Blocklist.h
    src/RequestFilter.cpp
    src/RequestFilter.h
    src/UrlInput.cpp
    src/UrlInput.h
    src/resources.qrc
)

# Add Windows application icon
if(WIN32)
    list(APPEND SLATE_SOURCES src/slate.rc)
endif()

add_executable(Slate ${SLATE_SOURCES})

# Generate a version header from CMake project version
configure_file(
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/Version.h.in"
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/generated/Version.h"
    @ONLY
)
target_include_directories(Slate PRIVATE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/generated")

target_link_libraries(Slate PRIVATE
    Qt6::Widgets
    Qt6::Network
    Qt6::WebEngineWidgets
)

# On Windows, prevent console window from appearing alongside GUI
if(WIN32)
    set_target_properties(Slate PROPERTIES
        WIN32_EXECUTABLE TRUE
    )
endif()

# "cmake --install" stages Slate.exe with the MSVC runtime DLLs beside it,
# so it runs on machines without the Visual C++ redistributable.
# build.ps1 adds the Qt libraries with windeployqt.
set(CMAKE_INSTALL_SYSTEM_RUNTIME_DESTINATION ".")
include(InstallRequiredSystemLibraries)
install(TARGETS Slate RUNTIME DESTINATION ".")
install(FILES LICENSE DESTINATION ".")

# Tests for the logic that does not need a browser engine
enable_testing()
add_executable(tst_slate
    tests/tst_slate.cpp
    src/Blocklist.cpp
    src/Blocklist.h
    src/UrlInput.cpp
    src/UrlInput.h
)
target_include_directories(tst_slate PRIVATE src)
target_link_libraries(tst_slate PRIVATE Qt6::Network Qt6::Test)
add_test(NAME tst_slate COMMAND tst_slate)
if(WIN32)
    set_tests_properties(tst_slate PROPERTIES
        ENVIRONMENT_MODIFICATION "PATH=path_list_prepend:$<TARGET_FILE_DIR:Qt6::Core>"
    )
endif()
